tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: The Military Chaplains Association of the United States of America (in this chapter, the “corporation”) is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Perpetual Existence.—
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the corporation has perpetual existence.
